#### [1. Awesome Nextjs](/content/unicodeveloper/awesome-nextjs/README.md)

##### Boilerplates

*   [Midnight Lite (⭐0)](https://github.com/vilqor/midnight-lite) - Free dark landing page template for AI and SaaS products with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui. MIT licensed. [Demo](https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com)

#### [2. Awesome Web Security](/content/qazbnm456/awesome-web-security/README.md)

##### Fingerprint

*   [Passive OS Fingerprinting: TCP Fingerprint, p0f and JA4T](https://packet.guru/blog/passive-os-fingerprinting) - How the first TCP SYN gives away the operating system family, why a proxy shows up as a mismatch with the OS the browser reports, and how p0f and JA4T record the same packet. Written by [packet.guru](https://packet.guru/).

##### JWT

*   [How to revoke a JWT, from a system that does it](https://easinvy.com/notes/revoke-a-jwt) - A per-user revocation cut-off from a production multi-tenant app: why it compares against `auth_time` rather than `iat`, the whole-seconds rounding bug it shipped with, and the routes that trusted the token. Written by [Ridam Agrawal](https://ridamagrawal.com).

##### SSRF

*   [Instance Metadata Abuse](https://ransomleak.com/exercises/instance-metadata-abuse/) - Shows how a server-side request forgery bug becomes cloud credential theft through the instance metadata service, and why requiring IMDSv2 session tokens with a response hop limit in the instance configuration closes the whole class of forging bugs rather than one code path, by [RansomLeak](https://ransomleak.com/).

##### Scanning / Sub Domain Enumeration

*   [ONUS (⭐12)](https://github.com/maverickaayush/ONUS) - Web vulnerability assessment platform that orchestrates multiple scanners, applies deterministic CVSS v3.1 scoring, and provides AI-assisted vulnerability analysis and remediation guidance.
*   [Crossfyre Toolchain (⭐256)](https://github.com/clickswave/crossfyre-toolchain) - Recon and vulnerability scanning engines in Rust for subdomains, ports, content discovery, fingerprinting, injection testing and nuclei-style templates, with one CLI and newline-delimited JSON output by [@clickswave](https://github.com/clickswave).

##### Decompiler / Server-Side Request Forgery

*   [Wakaru (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/pionxzh/wakaru) - JavaScript decompiler that splits production bundles from webpack, esbuild, Browserify, and Metro into modules and turns minified and transpiled code back into readable JavaScript, without executing it, by [@pionxzh](https://github.com/pionxzh).

#### [3. Awesome Rails](/content/gramantin/awesome-rails/README.md)

##### DevTools / Other external resources

*   [TestMu AI HyperExecute](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/capybara-on-hyperexecute-grid/) - Run Capybara browser tests on TestMu AI's test orchestration cloud.

#### [4. Awesome Svelte](/content/TheComputerM/awesome-svelte/README.md)

##### Internationalization / Form Components

*   [svelte-intlayer (⭐863)](https://github.com/aymericzip/intlayer) - Per-component i18n focused on bundle size. Declarative + compiler based i18n.

#### [5. Awesome Vue](/content/vuejs/awesome-vue/README.md)

##### Resources / External Resources

*   [FrontendAtlas Vue Interview Questions](https://frontendatlas.com/vue/interview-questions) - Vue interview questions with explained answers and runnable examples; free to read, some coding exercises are paid.

##### Projects Using Vue.js / Open Source

*   [Oxynote (⭐480)](https://github.com/oxynote/oxynote) - Self-hosted collaborative documentation built with Nuxt 4, Tiptap and Yjs: live Prometheus charts as editor blocks, draft reviews with visual diffs, and an Electron desktop build.
*   [EdgeChat (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/aozorae/Edgechat) - Open-source team chat built with Vue 3, Vite, and Cloudflare Workers, with group and direct messages, Telegram bridging, file sharing, and WebRTC voice calls.

##### Projects Using Vue.js / Commercial Products

*   [Beekeeper Studio](https://www.beekeeperstudio.io) - Cross-platform SQL editor and database client built with Vue.js and Electron, with a free open-source Community Edition.

##### Projects Using Vue.js / Apps/Websites

*   [A11yKit](https://a11ykit.site) - 15 free, client-side web accessibility and WCAG 2.2 testing tools with zero code uploads.
*   [Remove Audio Tools](https://remove-audio.com/tools) - Over 30 free browser tools for video and audio (convert, compress, extract MP3, make GIFs, separate voice and music with AI) that process files on the device with FFmpeg.wasm and WebGPU. Built with Nuxt and Vue.

##### Components & Libraries / Frameworks

*   [OpenVue (⭐421)](https://github.com/openvi-foundation/openvue) - MIT-licensed Vue 3 UI component library with a complete set of themable components, forked from PrimeVue 4.5.5.

##### Components & Libraries / UI Components

*   [File Viewer (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer) - Vue 3 file-preview component with lazy renderer presets covering 275 registered extensions, including experimental formats, across Office, PDF, CAD, 3D models, and archives.
*   [kritzel (⭐5)](https://github.com/kasual1/kritzel) - Infinite canvas component library for Vue.

##### Components & Libraries / UI Utilities

*   [Formhaus (⭐8)](https://github.com/formhaus-dev/formhaus) - Forms from one JSON definition for Vue and React.

##### Components & Libraries / Utilities

*   [Lingui](https://lingui.dev/tutorials/vue) - Internationalization for Vue 3. Write messages in plain language right in your templates, and Lingui takes care of the rest.
*   [vue-qs (⭐25)](https://github.com/iamsomraj/vue-qs) - Type-safe URL query state for Vue 3 and Nuxt, a port of nuqs. Writable refs synced with the search params, with typed parsers, batching and throttling.

##### Components & Libraries / Dev Tools

*   [vue-why-render (⭐12)](https://github.com/dadashi44/vue-why-render) - shows why Vue 3 components re-render: highlights renders on the page and names the cause (props, state, Pinia stores, route changes, computeds), with a panel and a Nuxt module.

#### [6. Awesome Micropython](/content/mcauser/awesome-micropython/README.md)

##### Communications / RFID

*   [micropython-uhf-module (⭐0)](https://github.com/HowManyOliversAreThere/micropython-uhf-module) - A MicroPython driver for the Tenhanyun TY928 UHF RFID embedded module.

##### Communications / Serialization

*   [micropython-msgpackc (⭐2)](https://github.com/Tangerino/micropython-msgpackc) - Fast MessagePack in C, a drop-in replacement for umsgpack.

##### Communications / Web

*   [MicroPyServer (⭐156)](https://github.com/troublegum/micropyserver) - A simple HTTP server for MicroPython projects.

##### Display / HDMI

*   [anx7625 (⭐9)](https://github.com/dmazzella/anx7625) - MicroPython porting of video primitives for Portenta H7 via USBC (to HDMI adapter).

##### Display / LCD Graphic

*   [MicroPython-Sharp-Memory-Display (⭐0)](https://github.com/peter-l5/MicroPython-Sharp-Memory-Display) - MicroPython driver for SHARP memory LCD displays.

##### Display / Printer

*   [coffee-edition-kit (⭐0)](https://github.com/ierolsen/coffee-edition-kit) - Pico W firmware that pulls print jobs from GitHub over HTTPS and streams them to a network printer over IPP, for a nightly newspaper.

##### Storage / Database

*   [ownSQL (⭐2)](https://github.com/TimonW-Dev/ownSQL) - A MySQL database driver for MicroPython, supporting MySQL Server 8.x and 9.x.

##### Frameworks / SRAM

*   [OreoOS (⭐9)](https://github.com/elixpo/oreo) - Operating system for an open-hardware ESP32-S3 conference badge, with an app SDK, on-device app store, OTA updates and native video playback.
*   [openbricks (⭐7)](https://github.com/1e0ng/openbricks) - Pybricks-style robotics firmware for ESP32: 1 kHz native drivebase control, serial bus servos, IMU gyro heading, line sensors, plus a MuJoCo simulator.

##### Tools / On Host

*   [thonny-ai (⭐0)](https://github.com/AstroQuestStudio/thonny-ai) - Thonny plugin and MCP server that lets AI assistants run code, monitor long-running programs and sync projects on MicroPython boards, visibly and with optional approval.

#### [7. Awesome Docker](/content/veggiemonk/awesome-docker/README.md)

##### Building Images / Base Images

*   [nginx-lua (⭐228)](https://github.com/fabiocicerchia/nginx-lua) - Latest Nginx with LuaJIT on six base distros (Alma, Alpine, Amazon, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu).

##### Observability / Reverse Proxy

*   [groundcover](https://www.groundcover.com/) - :yen: Monitor Docker containers via an eBPF host sensor — logs, metrics, traces, and APM, deployed inside the user's own cloud (BYOC).
*   [metriclens (⭐2)](https://github.com/tyshkovskii/metriclens) - Auto-discovers Prometheus metrics endpoints across Docker Compose services and visualizes them in a local web UI.

##### Where to Start / Wrappers

*   [Docker Terminal Simulator](https://devops-daily.com/games/docker-terminal-simulator): Guided Docker lessons in a simulated terminal in the browser. Free and open source, no signup.
*   [prepare.sh Docker Course](https://prepare.sh/course/docker-course) - :yen: Learn Docker in nine hands-on chapters that each run in a live Linux VM in the browser, from a first container to multi-stage builds, registries, volumes, networking, and image CVE scanning.

##### Security Articles / Wrappers

*   [Privileged Containers Exercise](https://ransomleak.com/exercises/privileged-containers/) - Escape a privileged Docker container to the host in the browser, then fix it with a non-root user, dropped capabilities, and a read-only rootfs.

#### [8. Awesome Cl](/content/CodyReichert/awesome-cl/README.md)

##### Agents

*   [nodecode (⭐176)](https://github.com/nodecode-ai/nodecode) - a living agent organism in Lisp. It becomes yours and evolves over time. MIT.

##### Graph databases

*   [Ariadne (⭐1)](https://github.com/hajovonta/ariadne) - A graph database in Common Lisp with full W3C SPARQL 1.1 and SHACL conformance, Gremlin-style traversal, RDF import/export, property graph support, inference rules, graph analytics, and Graphviz visualization.
    *   *Built with LLMs*.

#### [9. Tools](/content/lvwzhen/tools/README.md)

##### Response

*   [AppShot](https://arnavjhajharia.github.io/appshot/) - Free in-browser App Store & Google Play screenshot maker (device frames, captions, exact required store sizes). Nothing uploaded.

##### Favicon

*   [Favikit](https://arnavjhajharia.github.io/favikit/) - Private in-browser favicon & app-icon generator (real multi-size .ico, Apple touch, Android, web manifest). Nothing uploaded.

##### UI Builders

*   [Particle Logo](https://particlelogo.com) - Turn a logo into a particle animation in the browser, then export dependency-free HTML, Vue 3 and React components, or video and GIF.

##### Tools collection

*   [ogkit](https://arnavjhajharia.github.io/ogkit/) - Free in-browser Open Graph / social card generator (1200×630, meta-tag snippet). Nothing uploaded.
*   [cv.cm](https://cv.cm/en/) - 110+ free tools that run in the browser: JSON formatter, Base64, hash, JWT decoder, regex tester, cron and timestamp converters, plus image resize/convert, PDF merge/split, QR codes and a few device tests (mic, keyboard). No sign-up, 8 languages.
*   [All Tools Verse](https://alltoolsverse.com/) - Free collection of browser-based utilities for formatting, encoding, conversion and API work. No sign-up.
*   [DevToolbox](https://dev-toolbox.io/) - 30 free developer tools: JSON formatter and diff, regex tester, JWT decoder, Base64, hashing, cron parser, YAML and CSV converters. Everything runs client-side, no sign-up.

#### [11. Awesome Privacy](/content/pluja/awesome-privacy/README.md)

##### Video and Audio Conferencing / Desktop

*   **WhatsApp**: in 2021 Ireland fined it €225 million for not properly explaining what data it shares with Facebook. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/198) · [Source](https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/news-media/press-releases/data-protection-commission-announces-decision-whatsapp-inquiry)</sub>
*   **Zoom**: paid $85 million in 2021 to settle claims it shared user data with Facebook, Google and LinkedIn. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/2198) · [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/01/zoom-reaches-85-million-settlement-over-user-privacy-and-hacker-zoombombing.html)</sub>
*   **[BigBlueButton](https://bigbluebutton.org/)** - Self-hosted web conferencing built for online classes, with whiteboard, breakout rooms and recordings. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host · LGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Briefing](https://brie.fi/ng)** - Group video chat in the browser over direct WebRTC connections, with no account. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Chitchatter](https://chitchatter.im/)** - Serverless, ephemeral peer-to-peer chat with audio, video, screen and file sharing. <sub>GPL-2.0</sub>
*   **[Jami](https://jami.net/)** - Peer-to-peer audio and video calls and chat with no central servers or account needed. <sub>GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/cx.ring/)</sub>
*   **[Jitsi Meet](https://jitsi.org/jitsi-meet/)** - Video conferencing you can self-host; the official instance requires you to log in. <sub>self-host · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.jitsi.meet/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **[MiroTalk P2P](https://p2p.mirotalk.com/)** - Browser-based peer-to-peer video calls up to 4K, with nothing to install. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Mumble](https://www.mumble.info/)** - Low-latency voice chat with encrypted connections, on servers you can run yourself. <sub>self-host</sub>

##### Instant Messaging

*   **Facebook Messenger**: chats have been encrypted since 2023, but Meta still sees who you message, when, and who your contacts are. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/182) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.facebook.orca/latest/) · [Source](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2023/12/meta-announces-end-end-encryption-default-messenger)</sub>

##### Instagram / Desktop

*   **Instagram**: Ireland fined Meta €405 million in 2022 for exposing children's emails and phone numbers on Instagram. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/219) · [Source](https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/news-media/press-releases/data-protection-commission-announces-decision-instagram-inquiry)</sub>
*   **[Pixelfed](https://pixelfed.org/)** - Federated photo sharing with posts, stories and a chronological feed, without ads. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Location Tracking / Apps and services

*   **Google Find Hub (formerly Find My Device)**: reports your devices' locations to Google. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/217)</sub>

##### Centralized

*   **[Signal](https://signal.org/)** - Messenger with end-to-end encryption for everything by default, run by a nonprofit that keeps almost no user data. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Threema](https://threema.com/en)** - Paid messenger from Switzerland that works without a phone number or email. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Teamworking Tools / Desktop

*   **[Wire](https://wire.com/)** - End-to-end encrypted messaging, calls and file sharing for teams, with public and audited code for both the apps and the server. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>AGPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.wire/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **Discord**: a 2025 breach at a support vendor exposed government ID photos of about 70,000 users. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/536) · [Source](https://discord.com/press-releases/update-on-security-incident-involving-third-party-customer-service)</sub>
*   **Slack**: your messages feed its recommendation models unless a workspace owner emails Slack to opt out. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/206) · [Source](https://slack.com/trust/data-management/privacy-principles)</sub>
*   **[Rocket.Chat](https://www.rocket.chat/)** - Self-hosted team chat with end-to-end encrypted rooms and federation. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host</sub>
*   **[Twake Chat](https://twake.app/)** - Workplace chat built on Matrix, part of Linagora's Twake Workplace suite. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Maps and Navigation / Apps and services

*   **Bing Maps**: under Microsoft's very poorly rated privacy policy. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/244)</sub>
*   **Yandex Maps**: 11 trackers in its Android app, from a company bound by Russian surveillance law. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/ru.yandex.yandexmaps/latest/)</sub>
*   **Sygic**: 8 trackers in its Android app. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.sygic.aura/latest/)</sub>
*   **[OpenStreetMap (OSM)](https://www.openstreetmap.org/)** - Collaborative world map built by volunteers, and the open data behind most apps in this section. <sub>GPL-2.0</sub>
    *   **[OsmAnd](https://osmand.net/)** - Offline maps and navigation built on OpenStreetMap, with a large set of features. `⚠️ telemetry opt-out` <sub>Android · iOS · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/net.osmand.plus/)</sub>
*   **[Pure Maps](https://rinigus.github.io/pure-maps/)** - Maps and navigation for Linux phones, Sailfish OS and desktop, fully offline with OSM Scout Server. <sub>Linux · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Search Engines / Useful Tools

*   **Yahoo!**: a 2013 breach hit all 3 billion Yahoo accounts, which Yahoo admitted only in 2017. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/309) · [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2017/10/03/yahoo-says-all-3b-accounts-were-impacted-by-2013-breach-not-1b-as-thought)</sub>
*   **Yandex**: in 2025 researchers found its Android apps, Yandex Search among them, secretly linked browsing to device IDs. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/860) · [Source](https://localmess.github.io/)</sub>
*   **[Brave Search](https://search.brave.com)** - Search engine with [its own independent index](https://brave.com/search-independence/), from the makers of Brave.
*   **[DuckDuckGo](https://duckduckgo.com)** - Search engine that doesn't build a profile on you, with results drawn largely from Bing.
*   **[Marginalia](https://marginalia-search.com/)** - Independent search engine with its own crawler and index that favors text-heavy, non-commercial pages. <sub>self-host</sub>
*   **[Mojeek](https://www.mojeek.com/)** - UK search engine with its own crawler and index and a no-tracking policy.
*   **[Qwant](https://www.qwant.com/)** - French search engine, hosted in the EU, that doesn't track your searches.
*   **[SearXNG](https://docs.searxng.org/)** - Metasearch engine that queries other search services for you; use a [public instance](https://searx.space/) or host your own. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[YaCy](https://yacy.net/)** - Peer-to-peer search engine where every user runs a node and shares the index.

##### Third-party

*   **[Posteo](https://posteo.de/en)** - Ad-free email from Germany, funded only by its users, with optional encrypted storage and sign-up and payment that need no personal details.
*   **[Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail)** - Email from Switzerland, end-to-end encrypted between Proton users and with PGP, and stored encrypted otherwise, where a court order can still force it to log your IP ([2021 case](https://proton.me/blog/climate-activist-arrest)). <sub>GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Self-hosted

*   **[Docker Mailserver](https://docker-mailserver.github.io/docker-mailserver/latest/)** - Complete mail server (SMTP, IMAP, antispam, antivirus) in a single Docker container, configured with files. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>
*   **[Mail-in-a-box](https://mailinabox.email/)** - Turns a fresh Ubuntu server into a complete mail server with one setup script. <sub>self-host · CC0-1.0</sub>
*   **[Mailcow: dockerized](https://mailcow.email)** - Docker-based mail server suite with a web admin panel, webmail and groupware. <sub>self-host · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Mox](https://www.xmox.nl)** - Self-contained mail server in a single binary, built to need little maintenance. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

##### Clients / Android / iOS

*   **[FairEmail](https://email.faircode.eu/)** - Full-featured email app that blocks tracking images and keeps everything on your device. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/eu.faircode.email/)</sub>
*   **[Thunderbird for Android](https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/mobile/)** - Mozilla's email app for Android, built on K-9 Mail, which still ships from the same code. <sub>Android · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/net.thunderbird.android/)</sub>

##### Clients / Desktop

*   **[NeoMutt](https://neomutt.org/)** - Terminal email client with built-in PGP/GPG support, a maintained fork of Mutt. <sub>Linux · macOS · CLI · GPL-2.0</sub>

##### Email Alias Services (Anonymous Forwarding) / Desktop

*   **[addy.io](https://addy.io)** - Email alias and forwarding service you can host yourself, formerly AnonAddy. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[SimpleLogin](https://simplelogin.io)** - Email alias service you can host yourself, owned by Proton. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Alternative clients/modifications of Discord / Desktop

*   **[Aliucord (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/Aliucord/Aliucord)** - Mod for the Android Discord app that [disables Discord's tracking (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/Aliucord/Aliucord/blob/main/Aliucord/src/main/java/com/aliucord/coreplugins/NoTrack.java). <sub>Android · OSL-3.0</sub>
*   **[BetterDiscord](https://betterdiscord.app/)** - Discord client mod; add the [DoNotTrack](https://betterdiscord.app/plugins/DoNotTrack) plugin to block trackers. <sub>Apache-2.0</sub>
*   **[Legcord](https://legcord.app)** - Lightweight Discord client that blocks Discord's known trackers by default, formerly ArmCord. <sub>OSL-3.0</sub>
*   **[OpenAsar](https://openasar.dev/)** - Drop-in replacement for part of the Discord desktop app, with a [No Tracking (⭐3k)](https://github.com/GooseMod/OpenAsar#readme) option that turns off crash and error reporting. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Replugged](https://replugged.dev/)** - Discord client mod that continues the discontinued Powercord. <sub>MIT</sub>

##### Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

*   Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
*   Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
*   Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

##### Legend / Apps and services

*   `💀 inactive`: development has stalled. It still works and has no maintained alternative, so check before relying on it.
*   `⚠️ closed source`: the code isn't public. Listed only because of a long, trusted record.
*   `⚠️ source-available`: the code is public, but the license isn't an open source one.
*   `⚠️ website trackers`: the project's website loads third-party trackers. That says nothing about the app itself.
*   `⚠️ telemetry opt-out`: the app sends usage data by default, but a setting turns it off.
*   `⚠️ closed server`: the server code isn't public.
*   `⚠️ account required`: an account is needed to use it.

*   [mendwright (⭐0)](https://github.com/saadbuilt/mendwright) - Self-healing selectors for Playwright and Selenium in Python. Repairs a broken selector from a saved fingerprint of the element, asks a model only when that isn't enough, checks the repair on the live page and can write it back into your code.
*   [Replay QA](https://replay.io/) - Autonomous QA agent for web apps built on Replay's time-travel runtime recording and analysis. It explores an app from its URL, writes and runs Playwright tests, and delivers a root-cause analysis for each failure, backed by evidence from the recorded execution. Free tier, no credit card.

##### Software / Test Data Management

*   [Brume (⭐7)](https://github.com/brumeorg/Brume) - Copies a subset of a PostgreSQL database to a test environment, pseudonymizing personal data and keeping foreign keys valid.

##### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [bareenv (⭐0)](https://github.com/Blasword/bareenv) - Runs a command once per environment combination (unset, empty, invalid) and reports the ones that break.
*   [Cerulion (⭐101)](https://github.com/cerulion-inc/cerulion) - Open-source robot runtime that records each run and re-executes supported native recordings against new code, exiting 1 with the name of the topic that changed, so a recorded robot run becomes a CI regression test.

Fingerprint

SSRF

Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

  • Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
  • Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
  • Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

Its local MCP server re-runs a page with responses delivered in different orders to find races and replays one order to prove a fix.
  • mendwright (⭐0) - Self-healing selectors for Playwright and Selenium in Python. Repairs a broken selector from a saved fingerprint of the element, asks a model only when that isn't enough, checks the repair on the live page and can write it back into your code.
  • Replay QA - Autonomous QA agent for web apps built on Replay's time-travel runtime recording and analysis. It explores an app from its URL, writes and runs Playwright tests, and delivers a root-cause analysis for each failure, backed by evidence from the recorded execution. Free tier, no credit card.

  • Cerulion (⭐101) - Open-source robot runtime that records each run and re-executes supported native recordings against new code, exiting 1 with the name of the topic that changed, so a recorded robot run becomes a CI regression test.

  • Ponder (⭐3) - Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill for multi-pass deliberation and code review: grades every file or document across 6 dimensions, runs four adversarial perspectives (skeptic, builder, dreamer, empath), and blocks early stopping until coverage reaches 1.00 and churn converges below 0.02 across two consecutive passes. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder or npx skills add Quinnod345/ponder -y -a gemini-cli.
  • Log10x (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension that installs the log10x MCP server (MIT, local stdio). #### [1. Game Datasets](/content/leomaurodesenv/game-datasets/README.md) ##### API * [unicum.gg](https://unicum.gg/docs) - World of Tanks player, clan, tank and map statistics across EU, NA and Asia, free and with no key. [Website](https://unicum.gg). ##### Dataset / Web * [OSTDB (⭐2)](https://github.com/OSTDB/soundtracks) - Official video game soundtracks (2,300+ albums for 1,800+ games) with Spotify, Apple Music and album.link URLs, as CSV, JSON and SQLite. [Website](https://ostdb.net), [API](https://ostdb.net/api). #### [2. Awesome Appium](/content/SrinivasanTarget/awesome-appium/README.md) ##### Test Frameworks * [agent-qa (⭐911)](https://github.com/vostride/agent-qa) - Natural-language Android and iOS testing through Appium from vostride, with advanced memidex memory and self-improvement from verified runs. #### [3. Awesome Django](/content/wsvincent/awesome-django/README.md) ##### Third-Party Packages / Forms * [django-select2 (⭐206)](https://github.com/codingjoe/django-select2) - Custom autocomplete fields for Django. ##### Third-Party Packages / Monitoring * [django-health-check (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/codingjoe/django-health-check) - Pluggable health checks for Django applications. ##### Third-Party Packages / Task Queues * [django-crontask (⭐127)](https://github.com/codingjoe/django-crontask) - Cron style scheduler for asynchronous tasks in Django. #### [4. Awesome Webaudio](/content/notthetup/awesome-webaudio/README.md) ##### Packages / Frameworks * [Soundworks](https://soundworks.dev/) - Open-source creative coding framework for distributed applications based on Web technologies. ##### Packages / Libraries * [eko-web (⭐3)](https://github.com/reactivepixels/eko-web) - Web Audio playback engine for music players with gapless playback, crossfade, loudness normalization and React and Vue bindings. * [Bardkit (⭐0)](https://github.com/darkdarkcocoa/bardkit) - A sample-free plucked-string instrument for multiplayer games, with a four-voice pool and per-listener distance gain. ##### Packages / Utilities * [Audio Browser Lab (⭐0)](https://github.com/aribradshaw/audio-browser-lab) - Reproduce and diagnose browser audio playback, seeking, codec, and lifecycle bugs with shareable evidence. ##### Packages / Apps * [Database Inside a Song](https://blog.jasonsuhari.com/research/database-song/webaudio-demo.html) - Splits a stereo WAV, reconstructs its side channel, and visualizes the 18 kHz and 20 kHz carriers holding a byte-exact SQLite database. * [Tonecrafted Progressions](https://tonecrafted.com) - Free browser chord-progression player and ear-training tool for guitarists, no signup. * [Key Kalimba](https://keykalimba.netlify.app/) [Github (⭐10)](https://github.com/jonashuberts/KeyKalimba) - Interactive 17-key Kalimba trainer, falling notes visualizer, and real-time tuner with pitch detection. * [Melody Mate](https://melody-mate-khaki.vercel.app/) - In-browser generative MIDI workstation and melodic sketchpad using rule-based music theory heuristics and Web Audio API. * [Ocarina Simulator (⭐0)](https://github.com/zengm32343/ocarina-simulator) - A playable 3D ocarina with sampled and synthesized voices, breath-controlled dynamics from the microphone and song recognition. [Live demo](https://ootguide.com/ocarina/). * [Klaviero](https://klaviero.com/) - Falling-notes piano game for MIDI keyboards, built on Web MIDI and Web Audio (Tone.js), with in-browser audio to MIDI. * [psoup noise machine](https://psoup.art/machine/?utm_source=awesomewebaudio) - Free generative noise machine in the browser: brown, pink and white noise computed live with the Web Audio API, tuned by the moon and the day's earthquakes. * [seance](https://hexenwerkzeug.com/tools/seance) - Sample workbench on the Web Audio API: spectrogram, drum stem separation, hit-based slicing and BS.1770-4 loudness, all in the browser. ##### Resources / Tutorials * [Music Theory for Programmers](https://runjs.app/blog/music-theory-for-programmers) - Music theory derived from scratch in JavaScript, with runnable Web Audio examples. #### [5. Awesome Playcanvas](/content/playcanvas/awesome-playcanvas/README.md) ##### Games / YouTube Playables * [Street Fighter Combo Challenge](https://www.youtube.com/playables/UgkxGF7ES_oNTQGaOOKydm_B80zczREKGCRB) - Test your skills by landing combos in this Street Fighter tie-in. #### [6. Awesome Tailwindcss](/content/aniftyco/awesome-tailwindcss/README.md) ##### Tools * 🎨🌍🔧 [GradientDeck](https://gradientdeck.com) - Generators for Tailwind CSS gradients, palettes, shadows, glass effects, patterns & more. * 🌍🔧 [tailwind-dictionary (⭐1)](https://github.com/prosazhin/tailwind-dictionary) - Tailwind CSS theme generator from design tokens. #### [7. Awesome Homematic](/content/homematic-community/awesome-homematic/README.md) ##### CCU Addons * [ccu-addon-battery (⭐0)](https://github.com/hobbyquaker/ccu-addon-battery) - Statistiken über den Batterieverbrauch von Homematic Geräten * [ccu-addon-longpressdim (⭐0)](https://github.com/hobbyquaker/ccu-addon-longpressdim) - Dimmen mit langen Tastendruck über Schnittstellen- und Systemgrenzen hinweg. #### [8. Awesome D](/content/dlang-community/awesome-d/README.md) ##### GUI Applications / Status page * [hackerscad](https://hackerscad.com) - Parametric CAD where the model is code. Written in D, it uses a small subset of D itself as its scripting language. #### [9. Awesome Mongodb](/content/ramnes/awesome-mongodb/README.md) ##### Tools / Desktop * [Tabularis MongoDB plugin (⭐2)](https://github.com/TabularisDB/tabularis-mongodb-plugin) - MongoDB support for the Tabularis desktop client, including collection browsing, document queries and aggregation pipelines #### [10. Awesome Flame](/content/flame-engine/awesome-flame/README.md) ##### App Releases / Action * Broadside - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.illuminationdevelopment.broadside) - Sail a wooden ship up a sea of big-eyed creatures while the cannons fire on their own, and sink a sea monster boss at the end of every voyage. By [Illumination Development](https://illuminationdevelopment.com) ##### App Releases / Arcade * Pie Cannon - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.illuminationdevelopment.piecannon) - A carnival shooting gallery: fifty stalls down a world's fair midway, where you splat the ducks and spare the prizes, with a daily stall. By [Illumination Development](https://illuminationdevelopment.com) * Twinglide - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.teoktonos.twinglide) - Steer two wingsuit flyers at once, one per thumb, through an endless procedural canyon that narrows as you speed up. By [Teoktonos](https://twinglide.teoktonos.com) ##### App Releases / Casual * Peel Frenzy - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.illuminationdevelopment.peelfrenzy) - Peel a hundred fruits, each in one clean strip: trace the line, and a tension meter tears the peel if you yank. By [Illumination Development](https://illuminationdevelopment.com) #### [11. Awesome Zig](/content/zigcc/awesome-zig/README.md) ##### Fundamentals / Utility * [ensky0/tildaz (⭐21)](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz) - Native Quake-style drop-down terminal for Linux, macOS, and Windows, written in Zig on libghostty-vt. 1. Game Datasets

API

  • eko-web (⭐3) - Web Audio playback engine for music players with gapless playback, crossfade, loudness normalization and React and Vue bindings.

  • Database Inside a Song - Splits a stereo WAV, reconstructs its side channel, and visualizes the 18 kHz and 20 kHz carriers holding a byte-exact SQLite database.
  • Tonecrafted Progressions - Free browser chord-progression player and ear-training tool for guitarists, no signup.
  • Key Kalimba Github (⭐10) - Interactive 17-key Kalimba trainer, falling notes visualizer, and real-time tuner with pitch detection.
  • Melody Mate - In-browser generative MIDI workstation and melodic sketchpad using rule-based music theory heuristics and Web Audio API.
  • Ocarina Simulator (⭐0) - A playable 3D ocarina with sampled and synthesized voices, breath-controlled dynamics from the microphone and song recognition. Live demo.
  • Klaviero - Falling-notes piano game for MIDI keyboards, built on Web MIDI and Web Audio (Tone.js), with in-browser audio to MIDI.
  • psoup noise machine - Free generative noise machine in the browser: brown, pink and white noise computed live with the Web Audio API, tuned by the moon and the day's earthquakes.
  • seance - Sample workbench on the Web Audio API: spectrogram, drum stem separation, hit-based slicing and BS.1770-4 loudness, all in the browser.

  • Helix (⭐26) - Check a username on 8,000+ sites, re-verify every hit live against impossible usernames, and graph how the accounts connect.

People Investigations / GitHub

  • recap-cli (⭐0) - Free, open-source CLI to search and download U.S. federal court dockets and documents from the RECAP archive (CourtListener). Free API token required.

Company Research / GitHub

  • capitol-cli (⭐0) - Free, open-source CLI that tracks U.S. House members' stock trades from official STOCK Act filings, with committee cross-references and late-filing flags.
  • govint (⭐0) - Free CLI that searches U.S. government records (SEC EDGAR, sanctions lists, USAspending, GLEIF, FEC, SAM.gov, FARA and more) for a company or person, links the results, and writes a sourced dossier.

Web History and Website Capture / GitHub

  • Web Resource Ledger - Captures a web page as a signed, timestamped WACZ bundle that anyone can verify without an account. Web UI, API and MCP server, free tier.

Geospatial Research and Mapping Tools / GitHub

  • Aleph (⭐875) - Download satellite imagery, Street View photos, 3D models, buildings and elevation for any area or point on Earth. No API keys required.

Privacy and Encryption Tools / GitHub

  • Free Proxy List (⭐7k) - Free HTTP, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 proxies, tested and refreshed every 5 minutes, with lists by country. Useful for routing research traffic away from an investigator's own IP.

Maritime / GitHub

  • PortInsight.io - Free live anchorage waiting times, vessel counts and monthly congestion reports for seven major ports, measured from AIS with the method published. Free account adds port and vessel arrival email alerts.

60. Static Analysis

Programming Languages / Other

  • tern — A JavaScript code analyzer for deep, cross-editor language support.
  • Frink — A Tcl formatting and static check program (can prettify the program, minimise, obfuscate or just sanity check it).
  • TypeScript Call Graph ⚠️ — CLI to generate an interactive graph of functions and calls from your TypeScript files

Multiple languages / Other

  • CodeQue (⭐158) — Ecosystem for structural matching JavaScript and TypeScript code. Offers search tool that understands code structure. Available as CLI tool and Visual Studio Code extension. It helps to search code faster and more accurately making you workflow more effective. Soon it will offer ESLint plugin to create your own rules in minutes to help with assuring codebase quality.
  • SonarQube for IDE — SonarQube for IDE (formerly SonarLint) is a free IDE extension available for IntelliJ, VS Code, Visual Studio, and Eclipse, to find and fix coding issues in real-time, flagging issues as you code, just like a spell-checker. More than a linter, it also delivers rich contextual guidance to help developers understand why there is an issue, assess the risk, and educate them on how to fix it.
  • Code Intelligence ⚠️ ©️ — CI/CD-agnostic DevSecOps platform which combines industry-leading fuzzing engines for finding bugs and visualizing code coverage
  • ezno ⚠️ — A JavaScript compiler and TypeScript checker written in Rust with a focus on static analysis and runtime performance. Ezno's type checker is built from scratch. The checker is fully compatible with TypeScript type annotations and can work without any type annotations at all.

Other / Other

  • Frame (⭐109) — Security scanner that pairs taint analysis with separation-logic checks in Z3, plus an optional LLM layer. Symbolic frontends cover Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C/C++ and C#. LLM findings are reported in a separate tier from symbolic ones, and the LLM layer runs on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including a local one.
  • IDA Free ©️ — Binary code analysis tool.

61. Awesome Rust

Applications / Audio and Music

  • tsirysndr/music-player (⭐533) - Music player with Rockbox (⭐304)-powered audio playback, multiple interfaces, and streaming support

Applications / Finance

  • rsalianto/tradoor (⭐79) - Crypto trading terminal in the browser: candlestick, TPO and footprint charts, DOM, liquidations and a trading journal, drawn by a Rust engine in WebAssembly

Applications / Games

  • RafaelGoulartB/Heronite (⭐61) - A native game launcher for Linux and Windows built with GPUI: Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon Games, emulators and more in one library, with play time stats and a console mode

Applications / Graphics

  • jangtrinh/design-os-studio (⭐87) - GPU-accelerated interface design studio that opens and saves .fig files locally and exposes the open file to coding agents through an MCP server.

Applications / Image processing

  • heydeer/pngdeer (⭐553) - A lossy PNG compressor with automatic perceptual quality selection, available as a Rust CLI and WebAssembly app.

Applications / Productivity

  • emanuele-em/kanzo (⭐1.2k) [kanzo] - Self-hosted kanban board for humans and coding agents: a web board and an MCP server in one binary, with data in a local SQLite folder
  • ipavlin98/traydex (⭐99) - Native drag-and-drop shelf for Windows built with GPUI: keep files, images, text and links at hand, or drop them on tiles to zip, convert, OCR and upload
  • sunerpy/voltip (⭐55) - Push-to-talk dictation for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android with on-device speech recognition (Qwen3-ASR, SenseVoice) or cloud providers, built with Tauri
  • zhixuli0406/DuDuClaw (⭐50) - Self-hosted platform that runs AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) as AI employees on LINE, Telegram, Discord, Slack and 7 more chat apps, with result review, cost logging, local memory and a standalone MCP memory server

Applications / Security tools

  • clickswave/crossfyre-toolchain (⭐256) - Recon and vulnerability scanning engines for subdomains, ports, content discovery, fingerprinting and nuclei-compatible templates

Applications / Social networks

  • Signal
    • harababurel/faro (⭐52) - A terminal client for Signal, built for SSH and tmux.

Applications / System tools

  • lacs-project/sysknife (⭐203) [sysknife-cli] - MCP server and CLI that let an AI agent administer Linux through typed, approval-gated actions; a policy-enforced daemon builds each command and keeps an Ed25519-signed audit log
  • o2sh/onefetch (⭐12k) [onefetch] - Command-line Git information tool

Applications / Utilities

  • FortoGraphy/prism-download-manager (⭐902) - A cross-platform download manager built with Tauri that splits files into up to 32 parallel connections, with browser integration, video downloads, BitTorrent and crash-safe resume.

Applications / Video

  • mlm-games/Miniter (⭐95) - Non-linear video editor (trim, join, masks, keyframes, export) for Linux, Android and web, with the backend crates being usable from crates.io

Applications / Web

  • YOLOW92/pagesift (⭐261) [pagesift] - Web content engine for AI agents and LLM pipelines: crawling and main-content extraction to clean Markdown and structured data in a single binary, with a Firecrawl-compatible API and an MCP server.

Libraries / Artificial Intelligence

  • infosave2007/cmf (⭐53) [cortiq-engine] - Single-file quantized LLM format (CMF) and inference runtime with no ML framework underneath: CPU, GPU via Vulkan/DX12/Metal, OpenAI-compatible server.

Libraries / Bioinformatics

  • Ekin-Kahraman/rustscenic (⭐24) - Core pySCENIC and SCENIC+ gene regulatory network analysis stages with a Rust backend and Python API.

Libraries / Computation

  • oximo-rs/oximo (⭐112) [oximo] - Algebraic modeling library for linear, nonlinear, and mixed-integer optimization with multiple solver backends

Libraries / Cryptography

  • dsse (⭐0) [dsse] - DSSE (Dead Simple Signing Envelope) envelopes with PAE pre-authentication encoding: construction, signing and threshold verification, as used by in-toto and Sigstore attestations.

Libraries / Finance

  • 0xArchiveIO/0xarchive-quant (⭐97) - Rust backtesting engine for Hyperliquid perpetuals, with Python bindings
  • TA-Lib/ta-lib (⭐1.7k) [ta-lib] - Technical analysis library in pure Rust: 200+ functions, including candlestick patterns, with batch and streaming APIs

Libraries / GUI

  • mlm-games/repose (⭐10) [repose-core] - Jetpack Compose-style declarative UI for desktop, Android and web (wgpu-rendered, no WebView)

62. Awesome Neovim

AI / Diagnostics

  • mrwatts88/ghost.nvim (⭐3) - Write a question using a comment starting with ? to get a response from your favourite LLM via virtual text.

Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

  • dobsontom/dbt-ft.nvim (⭐3) - Jinja-aware filetype for dbt models, with Tree-sitter support for highlighting, folding, and indentation.

Programming Languages Support / Markdown and LaTeX

  • sammaji/markdown-preview.nvim (⭐37) - Preview Markdown files in your browser with support for math and diagrams, and synchronised scrolling.

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • heritage-themes/heritage-themes.nvim (⭐2) - [TS][LSP][L/D][Lua] A collection of 65 colorschemes drawn from the colour traditions of different cultures, with support for lualine.nvim and gitsigns.nvim.
  • RazikSF/lumina-themes (⭐3) - [TS][LSP][L/D][Lua] Fourteen colorschemes drawn from scenes, each in light and dark, plus a high-contrast pair.
  • kryptamine/gruber-darker-renaissance (⭐10) - [TS][LSP][Lua] A dark, minimal colorscheme based on Gruber Darker.

Startup / Cursorline

  • hawknewton/matrix-splash.nvim (⭐6) - Customizable Matrix-inspired splash screen.

Split and Window / Tmux

  • minhyeoky/tmux-oil.nvim (⭐16) - Edit tmux sessions and windows as lines in a buffer, like oil.nvim.

Pre-made Configuration / Stats Tracking

  • gamjagoon/earlgrey.nvim (⭐0) - A focused configuration with terminal agent notifications, per-language LSP controls, and cross-platform installers.

63. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • PolyDoc - REST API for HTML to PDF and screenshot generation. Including templates, PDF/A and PDF/UA output, privacy-focused, and more features. The free plan includes 150 conversions/month.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • UserNote - A user feedback tool to capture most wanted features, free supports up to 50 feature ideas and unlimited votes.

Security and PKI

  • pkgscan.dev - Multi-engine supply chain scanner for npm, PyPI, VS Code extensions, Cargo, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Go and AI agent skills. Checks for malware and known vulnerabilities, including hash lookups that need no upload. Free tier: 5 scans per month with full findings.

Mobile App Distribution and Feedback

  • WishKit - In-app feature request and feedback board for iOS and web apps where users submit and vote on features. Free forever plan with no card: 1 project, iOS and web SDKs, unlimited users, shows the first 5 feature requests.

Email

  • AliasMail - Privacy-preserving email forwarding and alias service with HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and custom alias handles. Free tier includes permanent email forwarding, custom aliases, and webhook integrations with no credit card required.
  • eForward - Email forwarding for custom domains. Free plan includes 1 domain, 1 mailbox, 10 aliases (catch-all ones count too), catch-all, and reply/send from your aliases (up to 5 new recipients a day). No credit card required.
  • FrostyVerify - Email verification, usable through a web app, a REST API and an MCP server + 1,000 Free Email verifications a month, no card
  • VaelMail - Privacy-first webmail with deterministic 16-digit account keys and zero phone verification. Free tier includes 50 MB receive-only mailbox storage, unlimited subaddressing, and persistent @vael.pw aliases with no credit card required.

Feature Toggles Management Platforms

  • Featureflip - Featureflip is a full featured feature flag platform that removes its own dead flags by submitting its own pull requests. Free plan includes 10 flags, 2 environments, 1 project, 3 users, and no usage caps.

Forms

  • Formlane - Formlane is a form backend for static websites, site builders or AI-built apps. One endpoint gets email notifications with reply-to, spam-filtering without captcha and a CSV export. All submissions are stored in Frankfurt. Free Plan: 250 submissions/mo, no trial.
  • Nisuform - Simple, Easy and Secure form backend for any websites with beautiful form template and intuitive form builder. AI ready with MCP. Free plan includes 100 free submissions, spam protection and turnstile.

Design and UI

  • logoapi.sh - Company logo API with no key or signup, the ideal Clearbit logo API alternative with SVG logos for any domain. 2M free requests a month per site.

Miscellaneous

  • Keeper.sh - A calendar syncing tool that keeps your work, personal, business or student calendars in sync. Free for up to 2 calendars, 3 connections, and give your agent or scripts access to read and modify your calendars with up to 25 calls per day.

64. Awesome Go

Email / Load Testing

  • xhit/go-simple-mail (⭐700) — Simple mail sending with TLS/SSL ☆701

65. Awesome Mac

Audio & Video / Utilities

  • GeiserX/akou (⭐17) — Call recorder with on-device transcription and speaker labels ☆19

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • nuanu-ai/agent-payment-node (⭐21) — x402 payments for Apple Silicon agents, owner approves ☆75

Developer Tools / Virtualization

  • MacHatter1/ContainerDesk (⭐5) — Native SwiftUI workspace for Apple's container runtime. ☆39

System Tools / Menu Bar

  • ateymoori/lyricglow (⭐44) — Menu bar lyrics for Spotify and Apple Music, with translation ☆44

#### [1. Awesome Mysql](/content/shlomi-noach/awesome-mysql/README.md) ##### Binlog-Replication * [dbtrail (⭐64)](https://github.com/dbtrail/dbtrail) - Analytical replica of MySQL: keeps tables as Parquet files fed from the binlog, queried with DuckDB #### [2. Awesome Roadmaps](/content/liuchong/awesome-roadmaps/README.md) ##### Infrastructure / Operations * [Cloud Engineer Roadmap](https://ciphemicacademia.in/roadmaps/cloud-engineer/) - Project-based AWS cloud engineering roadmap covering identity, networking, storage, deployment, infrastructure as code, and disaster recovery. * [Wyrcan Engineering Roadmap (⭐17)](https://github.com/Wyrcan-io/roadmap) - Text-first 12-stage engineering curriculum covering systems, DevOps, cloud architecture, and MLOps with interactive checkpoints. ##### AI / Machine Learning / Data Science * [Machine Learning Roadmap](https://quiddityml.com/blog/how-to-learn-machine-learning-roadmap/) - Self-study machine learning roadmap covering Python, mathematics, PyTorch, and ML foundations, with staged concept lists and study-time estimates. ##### Miscellaneous * [Knowledge Navigator (⭐5)](https://github.com/MohamedMuneerM/knowledge-navigator) - Interactive learning map with goal-based roadmaps and chapter prerequisites across STEM and other disciplines. ##### Articles & Books * [Frontend Framework Interview Preparation Roadmap](https://frontendatlas.com/guides/framework-prep) - Guide mapping frontend interview preparation across JavaScript, React, Angular, and Vue, with 7, 14, and 30-day study plans. #### [3. Awesome Parasite](/content/ecohealthalliance/awesome-parasite/README.md) ##### Scientific Journals * Bulletin de la Société de Pathologie Exotique - French journal on tropical medicine and public health. The journal ran from 1908 to 2020, when it was replaced by Médecine Tropicale et Santé Internationale. Full volumes are freely accessible from Université Paris Cité ([1908-1966, v. 1-59](https://www.biusante.parisdescartes.fr/histoire/medica/resultats/index.php?intro=bspe\&tri=\&p=1)), Gallica ([1967-1997, v. 60-90](https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/cb344790278/date\&rk=21459;2)), The Society archives ([1994-2020, v. 87-113](https://pathexo.societe-mtsi.fr/1844-sommaire-bulletin_L=1.html)), and RevuesOnline ([2010-2020, v. 103-113](https://bspe.revuesonline.com/numeros_parus.jsp)). #### [4. Awesome Quant](/content/wilsonfreitas/awesome-quant/README.md) ##### Financial Instruments & Pricing * [vanna (⭐2)](https://github.com/heykav/vanna) - `Python` - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P\&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion. * [stochPathSim (⭐15)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/stochPathSim) - `Python` - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports. * [CustomDerivative](https://cran.r-project.org/package=CustomDerivative) - `R` - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. [GitHub (⭐2)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/CustomDerivative) * [stochastic-rs](https://stochastic.rust-dd.com) - `Rust` `Python` - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. [GitHub (⭐194)](https://github.com/rust-dd/stochastic-rs) ##### Technical Indicators * [Repaint Check (⭐0)](https://github.com/arnjesix/stratcorealpha-pine-repaint-check) - `Pine` - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close. * [yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1)](https://github.com/eminsk/yfinance-ta-patterns) - `Python` - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data. * [technical-indicators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Pinxitu/technical-indicators) - `TypeScript` - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports. * [gamma-seed (⭐2)](https://github.com/Timonkru/gamma-seed) - `Python` `Pine` `Options` - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. [Website](https://kruegeralgorithms.com/en/research) ##### Trading & Backtesting * [QuantDinger (⭐13k)](https://github.com/OpenByteInc/QuantDinger) - `Python` - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers. * [ALPHAC (⭐1)](https://github.com/arhancanli/alphac) - `Python` - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record. * [trading-research-agents (⭐36)](https://github.com/BijectiveLabs/trading-research-agents) - `Python` `MCP` - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified. * [Desic Terminal (⭐33)](https://github.com/xiazhi88/Desic-Terminal) - `Rust` `TypeScript` - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited\_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated. * [Evidence Deflator (⭐0)](https://github.com/Beltran12138/evidence-deflator) - `Python` `MCP` - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions. * [OpenBacktesting (⭐6)](https://github.com/lucidcog/openbacktesting) - `Python` - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization. * [AlphaFinch (⭐2)](https://github.com/shloksobti/alphafinch) - `Python` `LLM` - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt. * [canli-backtest (⭐0)](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-backtest) - `Python` - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count. * [tilt-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/ssap-pa/tilt-check) - `Python` `TabPFN` `Gemma` - Pre-trade check and written audit from your own NinjaTrader trade history: sessions in market time, first trades of the day, re-entries after a loss, exit replay on minute bars, and written rules checked against the chart without look-ahead; never places orders. * [Optra (⭐24)](https://github.com/DuFanYin/optra) - `C++` `Python` - Options trading system: one event-driven engine for backtesting and live trading on Interactive Brokers, with pricing, volatility and risk research tools. * [Sharpen (⭐8)](https://github.com/bigcan/sharpen) - `Python` - Open-source agentic-AI quant strategy builder that tries to disprove a strategy before it ships, including Crucible, an alpha-miner (Apache-2.0). * [backtest-audit-kit (⭐0)](https://github.com/rytjy/backtest-audit-kit) - `Python` - Dependency-free audit toolkit for backtests (no numpy/pandas): detects look-ahead, checks cash/position ledger conservation, flags fee and funding double-counting, and mutation-tests your own suite for blind spots. * [Lumina Capital (⭐4)](https://github.com/ramuza0113-sketch/lumina-ai-hedge-fund) - `Python` - Autonomous multi-agent quantitative hedge fund engine powered by LangGraph, Qlib Alpha158, and Google TimesFM. * [TokIO (⭐4)](https://github.com/Kuzi-DEV/Tokio-ai) - `Python` `Pine Script` - Backtest significance checker with published false-positive rates: dependence-robust tests corrected for every variant tried (Romano-Wolf), deflated and probabilistic Sharpe ratios, probability of backtest overfitting, breakeven costs and a one-bar lookahead check, taking vectorbt portfolios, backtesting.py results and TradingView trade exports directly. * [perpbrain-sdk](https://github.com/PERPBRAIN/perpbrain-sdk) - `TypeScript` `MCP` - Hyperliquid perpetuals order-book fill simulator with fee, slippage and owner-limit checks, an execution-cost breakdown, and receipt verification that re-derives result hashes from the inputs. * [LR-AutoInvest (⭐0)](https://github.com/LLR6/LR-AutoInvest) - `Python` `CLI` - Offline daily-bar paper accounts with idempotent CSV updates, price-history revision checks, configurable trading costs, and explainable rebalance plans. * [matching-engine](https://rekurt.github.io/matching-engine/) - `Rust` - Single-node spot order matching with price-time priority, fixed-point prices and quantities, and optional write-ahead-log recovery. [GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/rekurt/matching-engine) * [tradefloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/simoncoombes/tradefloor) - `Python` `Rust` - Generates simulated stock markets for testing trading strategies and AI agents, with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, so orders fill against the book and move prices, and any run can be forked or replayed exactly. * [tradingview-mcp (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/atilaahmettaner/tradingview-mcp) - `Python` `MCP` - MCP server that gives AI assistants screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis and walk-forward backtests for stocks, crypto, forex and futures across global exchanges. * [IBKR-Telegram (⭐2)](https://github.com/GeiserX/IBKR-Telegram) - `Python` `Telegram` - Self-hosted Telegram bot for Interactive Brokers that runs next to IB Gateway: position snapshots and P\&L tracking, plus option orders from chat commands or webhook signals, each confirmed in Telegram before it is sent, with market-hours, duplicate-signal and position-limit checks on webhook signals. * [nt8-mcp (⭐24)](https://github.com/tbraman-dev/nt8-mcp) - `C#` `Python` `MCP` - MCP server and NinjaTrader 8 AddOn that give an AI coding assistant a build loop for NinjaScript: offline and in-platform compile with structured errors, chart and log reads, headless backtests, optimization and walk-forward; read-only by default. ##### Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis * [portfolio-risk-lab (⭐3)](https://github.com/garroshub/portfolio-risk-lab) - `Python` - Uncertainty-aware portfolio optimization: compare covariance estimates, test allocations across risk scenarios, and see the cost of tighter constraints. * [dca-ladder-calculator (⭐0)](https://github.com/BlitzTrading/dca-ladder-calculator) - `JavaScript` `Crypto` - Zero-dependency calculator for DCA order ladders on crypto perpetual futures that gives the average entry, take-profit, break-even and liquidation price (isolated or cross margin) after every order. * [Deadlatch (⭐0)](https://github.com/Diabloluo/deadlatch) - `Python` `MCP` - Local, advisory-only pre-trade risk gate for trading agents with 12 deterministic fail-closed rules and a local audit log. * [stochastly-calculators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Stochastly/stochastly-calculators) - `TypeScript` - Tested implementations of the probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratios, minimum track record length, probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV) and a seeded prop-firm challenge simulator, each folder giving the formula and its source paper. * [position-sizing-data (⭐1)](https://github.com/tk25719/position-sizing-data) - `Data` - Reference data and worked arithmetic for position sizing across forex, stocks and crypto futures: contract specifications (pip size, contract size, minimum step) for 131 instruments, pip value and 20-pip loss by lot size, losing-streak equity decay and drawdown-recovery tables, plus the risk-to-units formulas with two worked examples. ##### Time Series Analysis * [NoiseFloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/beepboop2025/noisefloor) - `Python` `MCP` - Offline financial time-series diagnostics, correlation spectra, change detection, and forecast evaluation with explicit coverage and input-data rights checks. ##### Market Data & Data Sources * [prop-firm-rules (⭐1)](https://github.com/kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules) - `Python` `JavaScript` `Data` - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator. * [canli-pit-lake (⭐0)](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-pit-lake) - `Python` `DuckDB` `Parquet` - Point-in-time market-data lake where every read takes an explicit as-of, corporate actions filter on when they became knowable, and delisted names are kept. * [Gloomberb (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb) - items.content_html:
1. Awesome Mysql

Binlog-Replication

  • dbtrail (⭐64) - Analytical replica of MySQL: keeps tables as Parquet files fed from the binlog, queried with DuckDB

2. Awesome Roadmaps

Infrastructure / Operations

  • Cloud Engineer Roadmap - Project-based AWS cloud engineering roadmap covering identity, networking, storage, deployment, infrastructure as code, and disaster recovery.
  • Wyrcan Engineering Roadmap (⭐17) - Text-first 12-stage engineering curriculum covering systems, DevOps, cloud architecture, and MLOps with interactive checkpoints.

AI / Machine Learning / Data Science

  • Machine Learning Roadmap - Self-study machine learning roadmap covering Python, mathematics, PyTorch, and ML foundations, with staged concept lists and study-time estimates.

Miscellaneous

  • Knowledge Navigator (⭐5) - Interactive learning map with goal-based roadmaps and chapter prerequisites across STEM and other disciplines.

Articles & Books

  • Frontend Framework Interview Preparation Roadmap - Guide mapping frontend interview preparation across JavaScript, React, Angular, and Vue, with 7, 14, and 30-day study plans.

3. Awesome Parasite

Scientific Journals

  • Bulletin de la Société de Pathologie Exotique - French journal on tropical medicine and public health. The journal ran from 1908 to 2020, when it was replaced by Médecine Tropicale et Santé Internationale. Full volumes are freely accessible from Université Paris Cité (1908-1966, v. 1-59), Gallica (1967-1997, v. 60-90), The Society archives (1994-2020, v. 87-113), and RevuesOnline (2010-2020, v. 103-113).

4. Awesome Quant

Financial Instruments & Pricing

  • vanna (⭐2) - Python - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
  • stochPathSim (⭐15) - Python - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
  • CustomDerivative - R - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. GitHub (⭐2)
  • stochastic-rs - Rust Python - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. GitHub (⭐194)

Technical Indicators

  • Repaint Check (⭐0) - Pine - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
  • yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1) - Python - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
  • technical-indicators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
  • gamma-seed (⭐2) - Python Pine Options - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. Website

Trading & Backtesting

  • QuantDinger (⭐13k) - Python - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
  • ALPHAC (⭐1) - Python - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
  • trading-research-agents (⭐36) - Python MCP - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
  • Desic Terminal (⭐33) - Rust TypeScript - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated.
  • Evidence Deflator (⭐0) - Python MCP - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
  • OpenBacktesting (⭐6) - Python - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization.
  • AlphaFinch (⭐2) - Python LLM - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt.
  • canli-backtest (⭐0) - Python - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count.

  • cors.dev - CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with https://proxy.cors.dev/. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.
  • Dynamic Document API - Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images. The free plan includes 50 renders per month and access to 2 templates from the template gallery or your own.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Enchant - Omnichannel customer communication platform. Free tier includes chat widgets, email newsletters, link-in-bio hub & more.
  • MergeMe - MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card. It adds CI status, mirrored comments, @mentions, reminders & more. Free for teams up to 5 developers & 1 channel mapping.

Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

  • Frontegg - Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and multi-tenant user management. The free plan includes 7,500 MAUs

Monitoring

  • Monitorable - Server health monitoring for Linux (bare metal, VMs, LXC): host and Docker metrics, systemd services and SMART disk health, with alerting, OpenTelemetry Collector agent. Free for 3 servers, no card required.
  • OpenUptime - Hosted uptime monitoring and status pages. Free tier includes 3 active monitors with 5-minute check intervals, 26,000 checks and 100 emails per month, and 30 days of check history.

Education and Career Development

  • BylineCV - Form-based CV and cover letter builder to pass ATS filters and organize all your versions in one place. Free forever for core CV building, exports, and storage, with daily AI limits.

Email

  • DMARCmetric - DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.
  • SignupVet - An API that checks email, phone and IP of new signups. 250 free checks per month, no credit card.

Forms

  • BootForm - Form backend for builders. Free plan: 250 submissions a month with unlimited forms. Email and Discord notifications, honeypot/CAPTCHA, and an MCP server so AI coding agents can create and configure forms and manage submissions.

Web Hosting

  • Pagehaus - Hosting for plain HTML sites, uploaded over SFTP or in the browser. Free plan: 1 site, 250 MB storage, 20 GB transfer/month, HTTPS on a pagehaus.site subdomain, contact forms, Server Side Includes and cookie-free analytics. No expiry, no card.

Data Visualization on Maps

  • opengeocoding.com - Source-available geocoder in Rust: address search, autocomplete and reverse geocoding on open data. Self-host it or use the hosted API. Fifty thousand free queries/month.
  • waymorphic.com - Vector map tiles (OpenMapTiles schema), MapLibre styles, geocoding and reverse geocoding APIs. No API key, no request limit, fair use policy.
